title: De Doncker DAB Converter Source Metadata

sections.heading: Phase-shift power transfer
sections.text: DAB power transfer is P = Vin*Vout*phi*(pi-|phi|)/(2*pi*L*fsw*N). Single-phase-shift is simplest but has high circulating current at light load. Extended-phase-shift or triple-phase-shift adds degrees of freedom for ZVS maintenance and efficiency optimization.

sections.heading: ZVS constraint
sections.text: ZVS is maintained when the transformer current reverses polarity during dead time. At light load or small phase shift, the current magnitude is insufficient to charge/discharge the MOSFET output capacitances, and ZVS is lost. This is the fundamental limitation of SPS control.
